purpose: Simple matched recovery comparison using the already-pruned community baseline; no Orin performance claim

pruning.method: downstream pointwise input-channel L1 weight magnitude
pruning.reason: Simple existing rule; earlier 445-image tuning comparison showed this width close to baseline. This is an informed exploratory choice, not a blinded selection.

comparison: Same initial pruned model and teacher, training inputs, order, optimizer and seed; alpha=0 versus alpha=0.5. Report baseline and both checkpoints on tuning images. Do not use the 654-image evaluation set for selection.
limitations: One width, epoch and seed; tuning set previously inspected; checkpoint pretraining data unknown; user-requested two-model demo does not imply eliminating experimental controls. No hardware or novelty claim.
